semantic.justification: Original BinaryStreamBase/BinaryXSeekableStream/SequenceSeekableStream position, EOF, alignment and actual UNO Reference owners plus BinaryXInputStream/BinaryXOutputStream raw transport and BinaryInputStream::copyToStream. Native virtual-base identity is lowered through a role mixin. Actual 32KiB Sequence buffers, two seeking queries, signed64-bit positions, count/atom loops, typed-only catches with owned exception cleanup and reverse member destruction are retained. CALC-360/WRITER235 preserve unconditional input closure despite false autoclose; CALC-361/WRITER236 preserve stale-buffer copy from an already-EOF input. Nine tests pass; unchanged whole-three-owner100 gate FAILS S176/176 B82/83 F32/32 L163/163 because the final sub32KiB copy request needs almost SAL_MAX_INT64 bytes. Source/counters/exclusions/thresholds unchanged. Numeric/array/string convenience templates, relative/Sequence binary input implementations, services, package/SAX encoding transport, full model/filter/worker/UI acceptance remain pending. Physical ABI/pointers/native threads/overflow/undefined atom sizes and original compiled differential are unverified. Existing browser file/autosave/recovery policy is unchanged. B8TCAE restores the actual original getLimitedValue<sal_Int32,sal_Int64> owner from include/oox/helper/helper.hxx. BigInt represents the exact signed64 argument domain; ordered clamp comparisons precede original signed32 return conversion. BinaryInputStream.copyToStream and SequenceSeekableStream.seek now call that shared original utility rather than duplicate its expression. The SAL_MAX_INT64 loop bound, read/write order, position/EOF semantics and source contracts are unchanged. An unchanged extracted original template compiled with exact-width integral arguments under C++20 supplies102 independent clamp/narrowing cases, including32767/32768 and signed64 limits. This tests the original helper directly; no claim of exabyte-scale stream execution, invalid-bound behavior, native ABI or full filter parity is made. Coverage thresholds, maps and exclusions are unchanged.
